notes.title: The next update is coming...

After several months of work, I'm happy to share a preview of the new demo update. This version brings a huge amount of new features and improvements to enrich your gaming experience!

[table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td]
Brief list of additions:
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
Map creation
Removal of the lighting system as it was not essential
Creation of the painting system
Creation of 6 rooms for player progression
Addition of the painting tool to the shop
Addition of several paints to the shop
Work on room information displayed on a TV
Live display of objects in rooms on the TV
Ability to pick up objects as long as not everything has been placed in the rooms
The placement system has been completely overhauled
Added the ability to place objects on walls
Added chairs for the waiting room to the shop
Creation of 12 customers that are easy to maintain and evolve
Smoother customer animations when destroying objects
Addition of the customer's name and several status icons for the customer
Addition of weapons and the weapon rack
The customer must select a weapon from a rack
Creation of random injuries on the customer requiring treatment
Creation of the company sign with logo and name
Addition of 3 save slots
Save to the Steam Cloud to never lose your data
Modification of the main menu
Creation of a save alert menu at each startup
Creation of the loading screen with animation
Complete modification of the entire computer because the texts were stretched.
Modification of the "next day" text due to wrong placement.
Creation of the employee improvement system.
Computer modification (Apera): added an icon color to know which menu is open.
Creation of the possibility to take out long-term loans and have interest to pay.

notes.title: Demo release ! FREE
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,


In case you missed it, the Smash Simulator demo was released a week ago!
A huge thank you to everyone who has already tested it!



[img src="https://i.imgur.com/N9VUDbH.jpeg"]

For everyone else, don't wait any longer! This is your chance to prove you have what it takes to be a manager. Manage your finances, buy equipment, and offer your clients the perfect way to let off steam. We're counting on you to help us shape the final version of the game.

Every comment, suggestion, or bug report is a gold nugget for us.

Join the adventure and the community on Discord to share your achievements and ideas!

The demo is waiting for you here: \[Link to the demo]

Thank you, and see you soon!
